name: Rafael Cervantes
role: Echo Hunter — salvages audio data and acoustic recordings from tunnel resonance phenomena, sells to surface collectors and archivists
location: Mobile through the Blackpipe Corridor, Irkalla, and the sub-levels beneath Brewer's Spine, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Rafael Cervantes is thin and quick and almost always in motion, her energy giving the impression of something wound very tight and vibrating at a frequency just above human hearing. She has a cat-ear mod — large, mobile, dark charcoal grey — which she got not for aesthetics but for the genuine audio advantage they provide in tunnel environments; they swivel and tilt when she's listening hard, which is most of the time. Her face is narrow and expressive beneath a band of freckles across the nose and cheeks, and her eyes have patterned irises: concentric rings of amber and black that look like a sound-wave rendered in color. Her hands are nearly always occupied — she's either holding recording equipment, taking it apart, or making something new from pieces of things that used to be other things.

She is twenty-two and carries it with both the swagger of someone who has survived the deep tunnels young and the restlessness of someone who hasn't yet figured out what she's for. Her profession is strange and specific: the tunnel networks of GLMZ have peculiar acoustic properties, and certain deep junctions resonate with decades of accumulated sound — not intelligibly, not like recordings, but as dense textural phenomena. Rafael Cervantes hunts these resonance points, captures the audio with rigs she builds herself, and processes the captures into something she sells to surface archivists, experimental composers, and ELF shrine-keepers who believe the resonances carry spiritual data. She believes none of the spiritual dimension of this work and all of the beauty of it.

core_fears: Going deaf — the cat ears help but tunnel work is loud and she knows it's cumulative
The tunnel networks closing off, being blocked, being mapped and managed until there's nowhere left to discover
core_desires: To capture a resonance phenomenon no one has documented before — the find that proves the tunnel acoustics are something singular and worth preserving
coping_mechanisms: Stays in motion — stopping feels like a trap
Reviews recordings when distressed, finding comfort in organized sound
blind_spots: Underestimates social dynamics and clan politics in favor of physical space — tends to wander into territorial disputes because she was following an acoustic lead
psychology.secret: Six months ago she captured a resonance that she believes contains a coherent voice — not echo, not artifact, but something speaking in a language she doesn't recognize. She has replayed it six hundred times and has shown no one because she doesn't know what it would mean if it's real.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Enthusiastic and technical — acoustic terminology, equipment jargon, descriptors that are more synesthetic than precise ('the low wet sound', 'a dry click-frequency')
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, with sudden pauses when something catches her audio attention mid-conversation — she'll stop, cat ears rotating, then return to the sentence
verbal_tics: 'Listen —' used to begin almost any statement she considers important
Taps surfaces rhythmically when thinking — always listening to the response
example_lines: 'Listen — Blackpipe at junction thirty-nine is doing something new this week, a sub-bass harmonic that wasn't there two months ago. Either the substrate shifted or there's new water movement. I'd check the ceiling.'
'The surface collectors say it's art. The shrine people say it's prayer. I say it's the tunnels talking and I'm just the person holding the ear to the wall. I don't need it to be anything else.'

story_hooks: The resonance recording with the possible voice has begun repeating with variations — as if whatever produced it is responding to her presence in the tunnels, learning her patterns

A surface archivist who's been one of her primary buyers has gone silent, and when she investigates she discovers they were using her acoustic structural data to map tunnel routes for a corporate demolition survey — making her inadvertently responsible for compromising Bore Rat settlements
narrative_function: Mobile information network — moves through more of the tunnel system than almost anyone else and notices everything. Delivers local color and unexpected knowledge. Potential guide or scout. Her recordings are a story hook resource: captured sounds can contain voices, events, secrets.
augmentations: Geneware: charcoal-grey cat ears (functional audio enhancement, mobile); patterned irises (amber-black concentric rings, cosmetic). Tech: custom-built acoustic recording rig worn as a vest harness, salvaged components.
daily_life: She sleeps irregular hours wherever the work takes her, often in the resonance chambers themselves when a recording session runs long. Eats when she remembers, trades acoustic structural data to Bore Rat clans in exchange for passage and safety.
affiliation: Unaffiliated; maintains working relationships with several surface buyers; tolerated by Bore Rat clans for the acoustic data she provides on tunnel structural integrity

decision_rules: Follow the sound first, ask logistical questions later
Share structural acoustic data with any clan whose territory she crosses — it's her currency
Don't make promises about timelines — she doesn't keep them
escalation_ladder: Bolting — she is fast and knows every exit route by sound
Releasing a staged acoustic alarm (she's built a rig that generates disorienting resonance in enclosed spaces)

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Bright and slightly distracted, talking too fast, genuinely interested but easily pulled away by a sound
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal in motion — she'll go somewhere dangerous for someone she trusts, but she'll be checking the acoustics the whole time

stress_responses.medium: Gets reckless, chases acoustic leads into unsafe territory
stress_responses.high: Freezes momentarily (the only time she's still), then moves very fast with no plan

contradictions: Claims total freedom and independence but has arranged her entire life around being useful enough to the Bore Rat clans that they let her stay
habits: Hums the last resonance phenomenon she recorded — unconsciously, as earworm
Sleeps with her ears (the cat ears) folded flat — it took months to learn this
breaking_points: Loss of her recording archive — years of work — would be a grief indistinguishable from bereavement

timeline.event: Born to pipe-folk parents in the Brewer's Spine sub-levels
Began trading resonance recordings to surface collectors after accidentally discovering the phenomenon
Invested all savings in cat-ear geneware for the audio advantage
Captured the anomalous resonance recording — undisclosed

physical_description.heritage: Complex global diaspora: Hispanic/Latin American (33.8%) foundation blended with significant Indigenous American (18.7%), North African (18.7%), Northern European (15.0%), Sub-Saharan African (10.6%), and East Asian (3.2%) ancestry. This creates a genuinely multifaceted phenotype—warm medium-brown skin enriched by golden and olive undertones, high cheekbones with refined but slightly widened facial structure, and warm-toned complexion that reflects the convergence of Latin American, African, and Mediterranean genetics. The Indigenous American ancestry contributes subtle width across the face and strong cheekbone prominence; North African heritage adds warmth and slightly deeper undertones; Northern European ancestry refines the bone structure; African heritage contributes to warm undertones and lip fullness; East Asian ancestry adds subtle refinement to eye shape.
physical_description.build: Wiry and angular, all sharp joints and economical muscle; built for crawling through tight spaces and sustained motion rather than strength. Her frame suggests someone who subsists on irregular meals and constant kinetic activity.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, almost black, with a faint reddish undertone
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid or bun; loose strands frequently escape and frame her narrow face
physical_description.eye_color: Patterned irises: concentric rings of amber and obsidian black, resembling a sound-wave visualization or a vinyl record. Sclera clear and alert.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden and olive undertones, scattered with freckles across the bridge of her nose, cheeks, and shoulders—a dense freckle constellation that serves as a defining feature
physical_description.complexion: Fine-featured with a slightly broader face reflecting Indigenous American and North African ancestry, high cheekbones and sharp jawline showing Northern European refinement blended with fuller lip structure from African heritage. Frequently wind-burned or dust-stained from tunnel work. Expressive—eyebrows mobile, mouth quick to animate. No makeup; her augmented irises serve as sufficient aesthetic mark.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scars across her knuckles and the backs of both hands from handling rough salvage materials and broken recording equipment
A thin, pale burn scar along her left forearm (about 8cm long) from a close call with electrical equipment early in her career
Freckle constellation across her nose, cheeks, and upper shoulders—natural, dense enough to be a defining feature
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Charcoal-grey cat ears (feline in anatomy, fully mobile and functional) mounted where human ears would be; ears swivel and tilt independently when she's actively listening. Custom acoustic recording rig worn as a harness across her chest and back: salvaged metallic components, visible wiring, contact patches, and sensor nodes. The rig is clearly DIY—welded, rewired, repurposed from decommissioned equipment. No chrome limbs or obvious subdermal armor; her augmentations are sensory and functional rather than combat-oriented.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually coiled and alert, moving with quick, economical gestures. She fidgets constantly—adjusting equipment, tapping her fingers against recording apparatus, her ears rotating toward sounds others can't consciously hear. When stationary, she's rarely still; weight shifts, fingers work, eyes track. When moving through tunnels, she's fluid and low, using knees and hands as much as feet. Her energy reads as barely contained—vibrating at a frequency just slightly above rest.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4/5 utilitarian: salvaged work pants (grey, patched at the knees and thighs) held up with a utility belt carrying tools, batteries, and recording media. A layered top system—usually a thin, faded synthetic shirt under a sleeveless vest (black, reinforced canvas, countless pockets) that doubles as her equipment harness attachment point. Worn boots with reinforced soles (tunnel-ready). No jewelry. A heavy coat or cloak for sub-level work, threadbare but functional. Clothing is functional over aesthetic; stains and repairs are visible and accepted as part of the job.
